opening.argument: The project advertises a BNB pool with a 10% daily return and 3650% APR, while the speaker acknowledges that “There's no real miner going on here” and calls it “the Ponzi scheme.” He nevertheless tells viewers that joining the first wave may bring a return within a month, offers a referral link, and closes by saying “you can give this Pisa Miner a try.” Those facts show the video promoting participation in a scheme whose stated returns depend on early entrants, despite the speaker's own recognition of its nature.
